scoring_justification: Full DFT recompute is infeasible in verifier; compare agent's reported numeric adsorption energies and distances to paper-reported reference values within tolerances (result-level compare).

hidden_assets.purpose: reference gold values for all adsorption energies and distances from Table 1 of the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper: Table 1. Adsorption energies and distances for NO, N2O, NO2, NH3 on Mg‑adsorbed C3B and pristine C3B, plus Mg adsorption energy (-3.20 eV) and pristine C3B band gap (0.66 eV).
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct transcription from published Table 1 and paper text (Mg adsorption energy -3.20 eV from Section 3.1, band gap 0.66 eV from Section 3.1).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper's own reported numbers, used as reference for reproduction verification; they are the target the agent must match within tolerance.

required.gas_adsorptions: array of objects each containing molecule (string), configuration (string), E_ad (number eV), distance (number Angstrom)
required.pristine_gas_adsorptions: array of objects each containing molecule (string), E_ad (number eV)

outputs.description: Compilation of all computed DFT adsorption energies and distances. The checker compares each numeric value to the corresponding paper-reported value using hidden tolerances.

output_contract.notes: Each adsorption and distance value is compared against a hidden reference with predefined tolerances. The exact tolerance values are not disclosed to the agent.
